comment: A150: the roster of OpenAI service-account identities the factory has federated to, current and historical. Following A144's policy/signing-identities.json, the historical value is demoted by meaning rather than deleted. The collectors and the requirement-2 spend driver resolve current_service_account_id and send it on the wire; the checkers accept any id in this roster, because the banked Results were minted against the historical one. policy/openai-wif.json stays byte-untouched and its service_account.id and rule.service_account_id mean only the account the banked issuance-era evidence was minted against - the same demotion A145 applied to that file's issuer.jwks_kid, and for the same reason: every banked OpenAI Result pins its digest as policy_sha256.

service_accounts.name: patchyard-worker
service_accounts.note: Minted 2026-08-12 by the console federation flow, which created the account and the mapping in one action (issue #183). No Administration API call ever confirmed it. Console-read live in patchyard and Default on 2026-08-12; absent from the project's service_accounts listing by 2026-08-18T02:20:11Z (issue #229, before that ticket deleted anything). Cause unexplained: the audit log returns zero events even unbounded. The four banked Results were minted against this id and retain it as fact.

service_accounts.name: patchyard-worker
service_accounts.note: Created explicitly inside proj_4zpZhhPPNYCvPRE5vGuRBALH and verified from primary source before anything depended on it: GET /v1/organization/projects/{project}/service_accounts returned HTTP 200 listing this id at role member with created_at 1787255650 (issue #267). That per-project listing is the only call that discriminates liveness - GET /v1/organization/users/{id} returns 404 for healthy service accounts too. The mapping patchyard-control-plane-to-worker resolves to this id with subject expression, audience, JWKS and Permissions unchanged.
